note.en: Practise controlled knee bending, hip hinging and ankle movement across the week. Increase the challenge gradually and allow recovery before another demanding leg session.
note.zh: 一周里兼顾可控制的屈膝、髋铰链和踝运动。逐步加难，充分恢复后再进行吃力的腿部训练。

title.en: One way to arrange a leg session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种腿部训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Warm up with a very light version, checking foot contact and a comfortable depth.
note.zh: 用很轻的版本热身，检查全脚掌接触和舒服的深度。

note.en: Use as the main knee-dominant lift after learning the rack routine with a coach; keep the catches set.
note.zh: 学会出入架后作为屈膝主项；请教练指导，调好保护杠。

note.en: Practise the hip hinge while fresh enough to keep the bar close and the spine steady.
note.zh: 精神仍集中时练髋铰链，杠靠近腿，脊柱稳住。

note.en: Add controlled knee flexion, including the short head; hip hinging is not a direct dynamic exercise for that head.
note.zh: 补上有控制的屈膝，包含股二头肌短头；髋铰链不能直接动态训练这个头。

note.en: Use light supported work to practise the sideways hip pull; practise both sides.
note.zh: 扶稳、用轻负荷练髋向侧面拉，两侧都练。

note.en: Finish ankle plantarflexion with the knees bent and the weight held securely.
note.zh: 用屈膝提踵练踝跖屈，始终固定住重量。

note.en: Practise lifting and slowly lowering the whole forefoot while the heels stay down.
note.zh: 脚跟不动，练整个前脚掌抬起和慢慢放下。

note.en: This illustrates exercise order, not a list everyone must complete. Choose familiar variations, do the demanding multi-joint work while fresh, and leave lighter isolation work for later. Stop when technique or comfort changes; rest until you can move steadily again. First learn with a qualified coach and a light load; anyone under eighteen needs adult supervision. This is general information, not medical advice; seek a doctor or physiotherapist for pain or injury.
note.zh: 这里展示安排顺序，不要求每个人做完清单。选熟悉的版本，精力好时做较费力的多关节动作，较轻的单关节动作放后面。动作质量或舒适度改变就停，休息到能重新稳稳移动。初学请合格教练指导，用轻负荷；未满 18 岁须有成人监督。本页是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；疼痛或受伤请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
